title: Behavioral conformance contract for run-beads-tasks.sh (pre-rewrite characterization)
description:
GOAL
The beads-runner is being rewritten as a distributed system (coordinator + controllable runners + web app). Most of run-beads-tasks.sh is scar tissue: blocks of logic that each encode a specific production failure. A rewrite that ports structure but not scars will pass its own tests and re-learn every lesson in prod. This task produces the GATE the rewrite must pass: a behavioral conformance contract.

SCOPE — STRICTLY READ ONLY
- Characterize beads-runner/run-beads-tasks.sh exactly as it exists today.
- DO NOT redesign, rewrite, or propose new architecture.
- DO NOT comment on the planned coordinator/web-app design.
- Output is pure observable behavior of the current script.

DELIVERABLE
Create beads-runner/BEHAVIORAL-CONTRACT.md. For EACH behavior, one entry with:
  - Observable behavior, phrased as a testable assertion ("a context-overflow task is NOT retried; it produces an analysis child bead carrying salvage guidance").
  - Trigger / black-box repro (how you would reproduce it without reading the source).
  - Source reference (file:line range).
  - Classification: SCAR (must survive the rewrite) vs SCAFFOLDING (bash artifact; must NOT be ported faithfully).

SEED LIST — verify each, correct anything wrong, and EXTEND with whatever the careful comb finds. Do not just restate these; confirm them against the code and add missing edge cases.
  1. Fresh context per task is the core invariant (header lines 1-3).
  2. Orphan recovery: in_progress AT STARTUP = crash orphan; in_progress LATER = another agent. Status-recheck in next_task() closes the snapshot→first-loop race (243-272). Cover the empty-ORPHANED_IDS edge case (245).
  3. validate_task TOCTOU: re-checks bd blocked (deps added after bd ready); bd show --children includes itself and is filtered; all-children-closed auto-closes parent (276-308).
  4. Classification order is correctness: a session accumulates multiple signals; decisive-terminal-first ordering (315-353). CONTEXT_OVERFLOW special-case: "Prompt is too long" arrives as errored result with stop_reason=stop_sequence, matches no token reason, and without the explicit pattern-match retries forever re-overflowing identically (697-707).
  5. Exit 0 != success: must verify bd status==closed; empty status fails OPEN to success; TASK_NOT_CLOSED is its own class with retry-once-then-analyze (319-330, 863-880).
  6. Per-class retry asymmetry: RATE_LIMIT invisible to per-task retry counter (830); CONTEXT_OVERFLOW/MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS skip retry; generic failures count toward consecutive breaker only if task differs (882-894).
  7. Exact fatal exit codes per class (AUTH, BILLING, consecutive-breaker, others) — enumerate them precisely.
  8. Consecutive-failure circuit breaker rationale: "avoid closing healthy tasks as skipped" (909-919).
  9. Watchdog kill sequencing: ps/lsof snapshot BEFORE SIGINT; staged SIGINT→wait 10s→SIGKILL; 180s soft warning; IDLE_TIMEOUT (721-760).
  10. Analysis-task path: blocks failed task via bd dep add; analysis-of-analysis infinite-chain guard; ID parsed from bd create stdout via sed (brittle); salvage guidance embedded in reason string esp. context_overflow (358-407, 847-861).
  11. scan_tool_errors: pattern-matched NEVER raw counts; patterns known-brittle/CLI-sourced; side-effects only, never changes classification/exit (470-510).
  12. Self-gitignoring LOG_DIR is a SECURITY boundary (raw file bodies/model output must never be committed) — * + !.gitignore (95-101).
  13. Selective stream preservation by class; proc snapshot kept only for WATCHDOG_KILL and conditionally removed otherwise (777-785, 902-906).
  14. Log rotation runs ONCE per invocation (not per-iteration) so it cannot race active runs (103-108).
  15. Preflight asset snapshot: wrong cwd / empty .claude/agents → silent agent failure; snapshot makes it obvious from line 1 (112-139).
  16. Model selection: label model:X overrides default; bare opus→opus[1m]; sonnet[1m] deliberately left alone (565-570).
  17. Graceful stop file detected promptly even during usage sleep via 60s chunking (529-550).
  18. Cleanup on INT/TERM resets CURRENT_TASK_ID to open so it is not left orphaned in_progress (147-162).
  19. Usage check posture: fail-OPEN on credential/API error; cached TTL to avoid hammering (166-235).
  20. Per-project config seam: .beads/runner.sh, runner_setup/runner_cleanup, PROMPT_EXTRA, PERMISSION_FLAGS, --yolo (20-69).

Also explicitly characterize the worker prompt (606-621): it forbids AskUserQuestion/EnterPlanMode and instructs "just execute, no human." Flag this as a behavior whose CONTEXT changes in the rewrite (an async human exists via a different channel) — but document the current behavior factually; do not design the replacement here.

ACCEPTANCE
- BEHAVIORAL-CONTRACT.md exists, every seed item verified (confirmed/corrected) with file:line refs.
- At least the listed edge cases covered, plus any additional scars found in a line-by-line pass.
- Each item classified SCAR vs SCAFFOLDING with a one-line justification.
- No design/architecture content. Read-only. No edits to run-beads-tasks.sh.
- Add a bd debrief note before closing summarizing what was added beyond the seed list.

title: Add CONTEXT_OVERFLOW classification to beads-runner
description: Investigation of 3 thirsty-backend UNKNOWN_FAILURE incidents (t4n4/dz47/npqp) found all were context overflow: long Sonnet-4.6 (200K) sessions hitting 'Prompt is too long' (stop_reason=stop_sequence). classify_failure() only catches max_tokens/length, so these fall through to UNKNOWN_FAILURE and get pointlessly retried MAX_RETRIES times (each retry re-overflows at the same point). Fix: stream parser detects result text 'Prompt is too long' + api error variants -> CONTEXT_OVERFLOW signal; classify_failure treats it terminal (before generic); handler mirrors MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS (preserve stream, analysis task on opus, no retries). Analysis task gets salvage guidance: inspect git log for completed phases, re-scope to remaining work only, consider model:opus[1m] or splitting.
close_reason: Implemented: CONTEXT_OVERFLOW classification in run-beads-tasks.sh (detects 'Prompt is too long', mirrors MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, no pointless retries, salvage-guidance analysis task); new security-reviewer agent template + conditional Step 1b in ios/android/backend wrapup templates redirecting away from built-in /security-review; scaffolder docs updated. Verified against 3 real failure streams; code-reviewed (1 fix applied: model:opus[1m]->model:opus guidance).

title: Add security-reviewer agent + wrapup integration to project-scaffolder
description: Built-in /security-review is a prompt-injection skill: it injects the full git diff into the MAIN conversation (parent_tool_use_id=null), unlike code-reviewer/privacy-reviewer which delegate to isolated agents. At the tail of a long autonomous session this pollutes context (caused t4n4 overflow) and yields a non-independent review. Fix in scaffolder templates: (1) new templates/agents/security-reviewer.md mirroring privacy-reviewer.md (isolated subagent); (2) wrapup templates (ios/android/backend) get a conditional security step mirroring the existing privacy-reviewer pattern that spawns the agent and explicitly redirects away from built-in /security-review (redirect, never bare prohibition); (3) setup-steps.md + init-project/SKILL.md updated to copy/inventory the new agent. Note: existing scaffolded projects (e.g. thirsty-backend) are copies and must re-sync separately.
close_reason: Implemented: CONTEXT_OVERFLOW classification in run-beads-tasks.sh (detects 'Prompt is too long', mirrors MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, no pointless retries, salvage-guidance analysis task); new security-reviewer agent template + conditional Step 1b in ios/android/backend wrapup templates redirecting away from built-in /security-review; scaffolder docs updated. Verified against 3 real failure streams; code-reviewed (1 fix applied: model:opus[1m]->model:opus guidance).

title: Add tool-error visibility to beads-runner
description: Watchdog visibility shipped in ef0226f; tool-level errors inside the stream are still silent. Add three improvements: (1) scan stream for is_error:true tool_results with pattern-match for high-signal cases (agent-not-found, permission-denied, MCP-unavailable), surface to beads notes + incidents.log + summary. (2) For agent-not-found specifically, send a desktop notification — this caught us with code-reviewer. Record + notify but do NOT change classification or fail the task. (3) Pre-flight env snapshot at startup: pwd, ls .claude/agents, ls .claude/skills, claude/bd versions written to preflight.log + one-line stdout summary, so missing project assets are obvious.
